# Kautusang Bayan No. 01, Series of 1991

**Appropriation of School Board Funds**

## Summary

This ordinance appropriates ₱34,445.16 from the Municipal School Board fund of Pitogo, Quezon for the year 1991. The funds are allocated for office supplies, activities related to non-formal education, repair and maintenance of school buildings and facilities, and transportation expenses. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo on June 17, [[1991]].

## Key Provisions

1.  Itinatakda ang Laang-Gugulin mula sa 5/8 ng 20% na bahagi sa buwis ng mga ari-ariang di-natitirang at sa balanse ng pondo na kabang yaman ng Pitogo, Quezon ang halagang ₱34,445.16 (Tatlumpu't apat na libo, apat na daan, apat na pu't limang piso at labing anim na sentimos) upang gamitin ng Pambayang Lupon sa Paaralan (Municipal School Board) sa pagbili ng DECS form Office Supplies, gamitin sa Non-Formal Education Activities, Repair and Maintenance of School Building and Facilities and Transportation Expenses.
2.  Ang Pangtaunang Laang-Gugulin Bilang 1 ng Pambayang Lupon sa Paaralan, serye ng taong [[1991]] ay isinasama sa ginagawang karagdagang bahagi ng Kautusang Bayang ito na minarkahang "Annex A".
3.  Ang Kautusang Bayang ito ukol sa Laang-Gugulin ay magkakabisa kaagad.
4.  Isinabatas ngayong Hunyo 17, [[1991]].
